preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of events m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in events if events[0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For each event of type 1, the employee numbers x and y must be valid employee indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in events if events[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For each event of type 2, the employee number x must be a valid employee index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= i <= len(documents) for x, i in events if events[0] == 3)
preconditions.description: For each event of type 3, the employee number x must be valid and the document number i must be within the range of given documents.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 3, output 'YES' if the employee has signed the document, otherwise output 'NO'.
